name: Fresenius Medical Care
tagline: Global healthcare company providing dialysis services, care enablement solutions, and value-based care programs
hero_kpi_rationale: La croissance organique des revenus de 4% au Q1 2026 démontre la solidité de l'exécution stratégique de FME Reignite avec une contribution positive de tous les segments métier, reflétant la capacité de l'entreprise à générer une croissance durable.

kpis.explanation: Year-over-year organic revenue growth adjusted for acquisitions, divestitures, and constant currency, reflecting underlying business momentum.
kpis.signal: Q1 2026 solid organic revenue growth of 4% driven by all segments
kpis.description: Q1 2026 organic revenue growth of 4% supported by Care Delivery, Value-Based Care, and Care Enablement segments, excluding acquisitions and divestitures.

kpis.name_en: Operating Income Growth at Constant Currency
kpis.explanation: Operating income growth adjusted for special items and currency fluctuations, demonstrating improved profitability and operational efficiency.
kpis.signal: Strong operating income growth of 10% and further operating income margin expansion to 10.1%
kpis.description: Operating income growth of 9.8% at constant currency in Q1 2026, driven primarily by Care Delivery segment, with margin expansion to 10.1% excluding special items.

kpis.explanation: Operating margin excluding special items and at constant currency, reflecting operational efficiency and profitability improvement.
kpis.signal: Operating income margin expansion to 10.1% in Q1 2026 excluding special items
kpis.description: Operating income margin of 10.1% in Q1 2026 excluding special items at constant currency, up from 9.4% in Q1 2025.

kpis.name_fr: Croissance organique du segment Livraison des soins
kpis.explanation: Organic revenue growth in the Care Delivery segment (dialysis and related services), the largest revenue contributor, adjusted for acquisitions and constant currency.
kpis.signal: Care Delivery organic growth of 6.1% in Q1 2026 driven by U.S. growth of 7% and International growth
kpis.description: Care Delivery segment organic revenue growth of 6.1% in Q1 2026, with U.S. organic growth of 7% driven by TDAPA reimbursement regulations and solid International growth.

kpis.name_fr: Marge opérationnelle du segment Livraison des soins
kpis.explanation: Operating margin for Care Delivery segment excluding special items, demonstrating profitability improvement in core dialysis business.
kpis.signal: Care Delivery operating income margin of 12.1% in Q1 2026 excluding special items
kpis.description: Care Delivery segment operating income margin of 12.1% in Q1 2026 excluding special items at constant currency, up from 10.3% in Q1 2025.

kpis.explanation: Cost savings achieved through the FME25+ efficiency program, contributing directly to earnings growth and operational leverage.
kpis.signal: FME25+ program savings of EUR 50 million contributed to Q1 2026 earnings growth
kpis.description: FME25+ program achieved EUR 50 million in cost savings during Q1 2026, with continued progress in manufacturing and supply chain optimization.

ai_positioning.summary: Fresenius Medical Care is expanding AI-driven interventions within its Value-Based Care segment to improve patient outcomes.
evidence: Expansion of AI-driven interventions for imminent hospital admissions of ESRD patients in Value-Based Care segment
ai_positioning.source: Fresenius Medical Care Q1 2026 Earnings Call Presentation
